federation_notes: Broad companies, products, model families, tools, and public entities are marked upstream-owned; this artifact keeps only local workflow, practice, governance, evaluation, adoption, or context-architecture implications.
follow_up_notes: Normal raw ingest should validate date evidence again for search-visible dates before synthesis.
Do not edit docs/wiki directly from this artifact; route through the raw project-wiki monitor.
privacy_notes: Searches used public leaf topic names, aliases, and public source URLs only; no private local wiki page text was sent as a search payload.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: TestDino published a 2026 guide that frames agent evaluation as task success plus tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, safety, latency, cost, repeated-run reliability, and human intervention, with deterministic graders for provable checks and calibrated LLM judges for bounded qualitative criteria.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Consider whether this belongs in agent-assisted performance optimization gates or the broader verification loops page during normal raw ingest.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Treat agent performance gates as multi-metric acceptance gates with hard deterministic checks where possible and calibrated qualitative rubrics where needed.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Performance optimization gates should not optimize speed or cost alone; they need release gates that connect latency and cost to task success, tool correctness, reliability, and safety evidence.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: OpenAI introduced an Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex that lets admins review workspace activity, credit usage, access, permissions, usage limits, spending requests, and supported admin actions through permission-aware tools and recurring workflows.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Route broad OpenAI product details upstream; retain only local operating model implications for plugin governance and admin workflows.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: When adopting managed agent plugins, record role/permission mapping, supported read/write actions, approval routing, spending controls, and evidence returned after each administrative action.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Managed-agent portability and plugin/runbook practice now need to account for admin-facing plugins as governed operational surfaces, not just developer-side skills or CLI packages. Cost and usage controls also become workflow-visible rather than separate console-only evidence.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: OpenAI published a Stampli case study describing Codex and ChatGPT Work used to connect product context, meeting notes, decisions, messaging guidelines, product systems, and business data into daily launch and go-to-market workflows with human review and final approval.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Evaluate during ingest whether this is a context-architecture update or an adoption operating model example.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: When context architecture supports non-engineering agent workflows, record which source systems feed the context layer, what gets transformed into reusable memory, and where human final approval remains mandatory.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Compiled memory and context-router pages can use this as a public practice signal that agent context layers span source-of-truth systems, meeting notes, decisions, and business metrics, while senior-led execution still reserves approval and strategy judgment for people.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Codelevate published a production-agent context engineering guide that defines context as instructions, retrieved knowledge, tools, memory/state, and guardrails; it highlights overload, stale retrieval, conflicting sources, verbose tool outputs, lost state, and permission leakage as recurring failure modes.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Good candidate for synthesis into context router, compaction, and request-package boundary leaves.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Request packages should name authoritative sources, freshness rules, tool-output shapes, state carryover policy, exclusion rules, and eval cadence before an agent is trusted with production context.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The selected context leaves can tighten their local practice around authoritative-source routing, high-signal context selection, structured tool outputs, explicit state, and permission-scoped retrieval instead of prompt-only controls.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Kingy AI updated an open-source coding-agent field guide with a visible August 24 official-source verification date, separating product fit from benchmark claims and comparing interface, model-control path, permission envelope, operational burden, maintenance evidence, documentation quality, current documented versions, and locally checked versions.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Route product details upstream; local pages should retain the evidence-label and version-freshness practice.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Agent-runtime selection ledgers should separate product identity, release freshness, local installation evidence, permission envelope, and unresolved benchmark coverage instead of collapsing them into rankings.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Runtime updater integrity and portability practice benefit from distinguishing official release freshness from locally checked versions, and from withholding comparative performance claims when coverage gates are incomplete.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Hao Zhang published an essay framing the AI-agent bottleneck as coherent shared information for many autonomous readers and writers, treating it as continual, multi-writer semantic data integration with context construction as the read interface.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Open page only exposes year-level date while search exposed yesterday; keep the date-evidence caveat during ingest.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Document context architecture as a shared information system with write governance, semantic integration, and read-time context construction, not just retrieval over static documents.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: Compiled wiki, context router, and lifespan documentation pages can use this as a local-practice signal for multi-writer governance, source coherence, and context construction from maintained shared information stores.

selection_policy: New or unchecked leaves first, then oldest last_checked_at, ties by stable relative path sort.
